sources.title: Myanmar eVisa: Notice to Tourist Visa Applicants
sources.officialityEvidence: The page title identifies Myanmar eVisa Official Government and it is served on the Ministry's moip.gov.mm eVisa subdomain. On re-review, the public frontend loaded only an application shell and its deployed API base URL was blank, so the notice's dynamic country data was not independently reproducible without an authenticated or legacy backend.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary passport holders from the following countries/ region ... are eligible to apply Tourist Visa.

sources.title: Myanmar Ministry of Foreign Affairs: On-Arrival Visa Information
sources.officialityEvidence: The live page is published directly on the Myanmar Ministry of Foreign Affairs' mofa.gov.mm domain and identifies the Republic of the Union of Myanmar. Its named tourist-VOA additions expressly carry a 1 January 2020 start date, so it is not treated as an exhaustive current complement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passport holder from the following countries are eligible to apply Visa On Arrival for Tourist Visa.

sources.title: List of Countries Having Bilateral Visa Exemption Agreements with Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: The document is hosted directly by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on mofa.gov.mm and identifies itself as the current bilateral exemption schedule as of 27 January 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List of Countries Having Bilateral Visa Exemption Agreements with Myanmar (As of 27 Jan 2026).
